title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

current_candidate.summary: Green Nave v7: tall repeated structural arches inside one continuous textured envelope, with side walls kept materially filled and darkness concentrated in the distant center.

open_feedback: New candidate must be judged against the supplied green-arch reference: it should read as one tall interior, not stacked images.
Arches must read as structural thresholds with thickness, not translucent or flat picture frames.
Side walls must remain materially present; lateral black voids are rejected.
Height and floor-led depth must make the viewer feel small.
The only strong darkness should collect toward the central depth/throat.
Preserve continuous ground, yaw-only look controls, and believable perspective.
